---
title: "Balance check in differences"
format: html
---


Referee reports both asked us to check the balance of the coveratiates that we observe in the pre period in differences rather than in levels. In other words, they want to see if the changes in populations by different occupations was changing in the same way in the treatment and control groups.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("data", "balance-tests", "filtered_data_with_distances_balanced_few_columns.xlsx"))

df %>% distinct()

# calculate change in each variable between 1890 and 1900

library(haven)

df %>%
    filter(year %in% c(1890, 1900)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(shc1, shc2, shc3, shc4, shc5, shc6, shc7, llabforce), values_to = "value", names_to = "variable") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = value)  %>% 
    mutate(change = `1900` - `1890`)  %>% 
    select(parish_name_x, parish_code_short, treated, variable, change) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = change)   %>% 
    write_dta(here::here("data", "balance-tests", "filtered_data_with_distances_balanced_changes.dta"))
    # write_csv(here::here("data", "balance-tests", "filtered_data_with_distances_balanced_changes.csv"))



```
